description_en: Queries the basic metadata information about a compute engine instance
description_zh: 该接口用于获取引擎实例的基本元数据信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-db-info --app-guid odps.some_engine_name --cluster-id abc --database-name abc --data-source-type emr --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaDBInfo

parameters.help_en: The compute engine instance ID. Specify the ID in the `Engine type.Engine name` format
parameters.help_zh: 引擎ID，格式为`引擎类型.引擎名称`
parameters.name: app_guid

parameters.help_en: The name of the metadatabase of the EMR cluster
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Valid values: odps and emr
parameters.name: data_source_type
